text: Birsa Munda, the revered tribal freedom fighter, led the famous 'Ulgulan' (Great Tumult) in which present-day Indian state?
explanation: Birsa Munda led the historic movement in the Chotanagpur region of Jharkhand.

text: Which Indian temple is renowned for its grand 24 intricately carved stone chariot wheels representing the sun god?
explanation: The Sun Temple at Konark, Odisha was built in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I.

text: Which classical Indian dance form originates from Kerala and is characterized by elaborate makeup and dramatic storytelling?
explanation: Kathakali is the traditional story-play dance of Kerala.

text: The Warli folk painting tradition originated and is practiced primarily in which Indian state?
explanation: Warli painting is a traditional tribal art form of the Warli tribe in Maharashtra.

text: [Audio Round] Listen to the audio clip. Identify the classical Indian musical instrument featured in this piece.
explanation: The Sitar is a plucked string instrument central to Hindustani classical music.

text: [Visual Round] Identify this famous UNESCO World Heritage monument located in Agra, India.
explanation: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in 1631.

text: Which ancient Sanskrit epic composed by Valmiki is revered as the Adi Kavya (first poem) in Indian literature?
explanation: The Ramayana of sage Valmiki is traditionally known as the Adi Kavya.

text: The ancient living root bridges, handcrafted from the aerial roots of rubber trees, are found in which Indian state?
explanation: Living root bridges are created by the Khasi and Jaintia tribes of Meghalaya.

text: The famous tribal revolutionary hero Tantia Bhil, revered as the 'Robin Hood of India', fought in which region?
explanation: Tantia Bhil led active resistance against British exploitation in Central India.
